title: Internship: Global Wholesale Banking COO – Communications, Strategy and Employee experience
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
Who will you be working with?
As an intern Communications, Strategy and Employee Experience, you will join the Business Management team of the Chief Operations Officer of the Wholesale Bank. The culture is open and informal, with a strong emphasis on personal responsibility, collaboration, and team spirit. We operate in more than 30 countries worldwide, working every day to improve our operational customer processes.
What will your daily activities involve?
As a working intern at WB COO, you will contribute to communications about strategic projects and programmes aimed at strengthening our processes and organisation for ING’s largest clients. You will be actively involved with the latest developments in digitalisation, GenAI, and performance measurement using real-time dashboards. We set the bar higher every day to deliver faster and better services to our clients. As an intern, you will support teams, Leadership and with high responsibilities globally, ranging from Asia to America, in areas such as Lending and Financial Markets. Your tasks will include making analysis and preparing and making project documents and presentations. The dynamic nature of the team’s work means you will quickly learn about different markets, clients, and processes. You will work closely with Leadership, giving you first-hand experience of how decisions and execution are made.
Who are we looking for?
We are seeking a driven, pro-active and strategically minded student with strong execution skills. You are creative, and have an affinity for complex issues. You are also a good team player, resilient to stress, and have a drive to improve things.
You are pursuing a bachelor or master’s degree, preferably in communications, economics, complemented by extracurricular activities.
You are skilled in PowerPoint, Excel, and PowerBi.
You have excellent command of English, both spoken and written.
You are available from 1 February 2026 (or earlier), for a period of 6 months.
This is a great opportunity to train with highly skilled people who are experts in their field. You’ll do a lot and learn a lot – not only about your specialist area and the bank, but also about yourself and whether this type of environment is right for you.
You’ll also benefit from:
Internship allowance of 700 EUR based on a 36 hours work week
Internship allowance of 700 EUR based on a 36 hours work week
Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
During the duration of your internship at ING, it is mandatory to be enrolled at a Dutch university (or EU-university for EU passport holders).
Do you recognise yourself in this profile? Apply now!
About our internships
Every year, more than 350 students join our internship program. While there are no guarantees about your future, many of our former interns move into a permanent role or onto our International Talent Programme (traineeship).
Whatever happens, an internship at ING is the ideal opportunity to meet a wide variety of people, to build up your own network, and to learn about many different aspects of banking – put simply, it’s a great start to your career.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
